🕸️[[1 Categories in Digital Garden/Mind Palace\|Mind Palace]] , [[Valorant Maps\|Valorant Maps]]

[[1 Categories in Digital Garden/Status - Trees🌳🌲\|Status - Trees🌳🌲]]
⚡[[1 Categories in Digital Garden/Mem-Tables&Scaffolds\|Mem-Tables&Scaffolds]]

I have enjoyed my time playing Valorant and other FPS Games.  Valorant is a game where I have spent enough time in to remember map callouts and create a mind palace. 

I am using Mind Palace from Valorant as a scaffold to learn real knowledge. Something to enhance my memory. 

Everything in this map is a flow then.
So let's take a mental walk in one of our maps of Valorant called Ascent

It is divided into 3 parts. 

1. A side - 15 Points
2. Middle - 12 Points
3. B side - 14 Points


Can I remember all of them? Write them down on a piece of paper.


> [!note]- Map Callouts Reference
> | A Side Number | Callout   | Mid Side Number | Call Out       | B Side Number | Call Out     |
> | ------------- | --------- | --------------- | -------------- | ------------- | ------------ |
> | A1            | Tp Point  | M1              | Ramps          | B1            | Attacker     |
> | A2            | Cafe      | M2              | Defender Spawn | B2            | Lobby        |
> | A3            | Bicycle   | M3              | Spawn Cubby    | B3            | Ticket Booth |
> | A4            | A orb     | M4              | Market         | B4            | B orb        |
> | A5            | A Main    | M5              | Pizza          | B5            | B Main       |
> | A6            | A Wine    | M6              | Mid Bottom     | B6            | B cubby      |
> | A7            | Bricks    | M7              | Screens        | B7            | B Logs       |
> | A8            | A Dices   | M8              | Courtyard      | B8            | B CT         |
> | A9            | Heaven    | M9              | Subroza        | B9            | Stairs       |
> | A10           | Window    | M10             | Midtop         | B10           | B Double     |
> | A11           | Garden    | M11             | Catwalk        | B11           | B Triple     |
> | A12           | Tree      | M12             | Mid Cubby      | B12           | B Boathouse  |
> | A13           | Doors     |                 |                | B13           | B lane       |
> | A14           | Generator |                 |                | B14           | B Switch hut |
> | A15           | Hell      |                 |                |               |              |
